scope: Two additional frozen targeting/hard-denial paragraphs; original three supports remain in the100-source inventory.

supportingSources.text: Unless expressly stated, perceive the target, remain within range and have line of effect; total cover blocks targeting. “Ally” includes self unless it says OTHER. A list cannot contain a creature twice. Select up to the printed limit; an empty target list is not a valid way to farm activation benefits. Zones remain at their chosen point unless described as an aura; allies can leave and lose their benefits. An aura requires its owner conscious unless the card supplies a bounded exception. An effect ending at “end next turn” means the affected creature's next turn only when the card says target's; otherwise the user's.

No repeated hard denial without a new save and cost. For this class suite, a creature can suffer **Stunned, compelled loss of its whole Action/turn, or equivalent hard denial from a given character at most once per encounter**, across that character's class features; later such riders fail while damage and soft riders resolve normally. Record source and target. This draft guard is broader than the older Oracle-only ceiling and is an explicit balance proposal. Reaction denial, Speed reduction, penalties and Frightened do not count as whole-turn loss. Do not silently waive boss immunities, legendary defenses or anatomy.
